mapper.select: select t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at as created_at, t.enabled, r.authority, r.alias, r.tenant_id, o.id as orgId, o.alias as orgAlias, ol.is_online, ol.offline_time, tc.nickname as created_by, t.expired_time from la_users t left join (select t1.username,t1.authority, t2.alias, t2.tenant_id from la_user_roles t1 inner join la_roles t2 on t2.authority = t1.authority and t2.enabled = 1) r on r.username = t.username left join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username left join la_organization o on o.id = uo.organization_id left join la_user_online_logs ol on t.username = ol.username left join la_users tc on t.created_by = tc.username where t.username in #{user.username} order by t.created_at desc, t.username

select t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at as created_at, t.enabled, r.authority, r.alias, o.id as orgId, o.alias as orgAlias, t.expired_time from la_users t left join la_user_roles u on u.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = u.authority left join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username left join la_organization o on o.id = uo.organization_id
and (t.username like concat(concat('%',#{key}),'%') or t.nickname like concat(concat('%',#{key}),'%') or t.mobile like concat(concat('%',#{key}),'%') or t.email like concat(concat('%',#{key}),'%'))
order by t.username

select t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at as created_at, t.enabled, t.tenant_id, r.authority, r.alias, o.id as orgId, o.alias as orgAlias, t.expired_time, ol.is_online, ol.offline_time from la_users t left join la_user_roles ur on ur.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = ur.authority left join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username left join la_organization o on o.id = uo.organization_id left join la_user_online_logs ol on t.username = ol.username where t.username = #{username}
select t.username, t.password from la_users t where t.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: insert into la_users (username, password, nickname, mobile, email, created_at, enabled, tenant_id, created_by, expired_time) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{mobile,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, 1, #{tenantId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expiredTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select count(1) from dual where exists (select 1 from la_users t where t.username = #{username})
mapper.update: update la_users set password = #{password} where username = #{username}
update la_users set enabled = #{enabled} where username = #{username}
mapper.select: select distinct t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at as created_at, t.enabled, r.authority, r.alias, o.id as orgId, o.alias as orgAlias, t.expired_time from la_users t left join la_user_roles u on u.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = u.authority left join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username left join la_organization o on o.id = uo.organization_id

select t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at as created_at, t.enabled, r.authority, r.alias, o.id as orgId, o.alias as orgAlias from la_users t left join la_user_roles u on u.username = t.username left join la_roles r on r.authority = u.authority left join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username left join la_organization o on o.id = uo.organization_id where uo.organization_id = #{orgId}

select t1.id, t1.res_name, t1.parent_id from la_resources t1 where t1.res_type != 0
and t1.id in ( select distinct t.resource_id from la_role_resources t where t.authority in #{item} )
and t1.res_mode = #{mode}
order by t1.res_level, t1.parent_id, t1.orderno
select distinct t.resource_id from la_role_resources t where t.authority = #{username}

select t.username, t.nickname, t.mobile, t.email, t.created_at, t.enabled, t.tenant_id, ur.authority as authority, uo.organization_id as orgId from la_users t inner join la_user_roles ur on ur.username = t.username inner join la_user_organization uo on t.username = uo.username
and uo.organization_id = #{tenantId}
and ur.authority = 'ROLE_TENANT'
order by t.username
select count(1) from dual where exists(select 1 from la_users t where t.mobile = #{mobile})

select t.tenant_id from la_user_organization uo inner join la_user_roles ur on ur.username = uo.username inner join la_tenant t on uo.organization_id = t.tenant_id where ur.authority = 'ROLE_TENANT' and uo.username = #{username}
